commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' The ball is out of play. Bournemouth win a corner kick.
90+4' The corner from Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is hurriedly cleared.
90+3' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Bournemouth get a corner.
90+2' Amadou Onana (Aston Villa) plays a one-two with Lamare Bogarde, but the move breaks down.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) replaces Evanilson.
88' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) receives a quality pass inside the box and fires a first-time shot. His effort towards the left post is saved by the goalkeeper.
87' Here comes a substitution. David Brooks (Bournemouth) is brought on as a substitute for Rayan.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Adam Smith (Bournemouth) coming on for Alejandro Jimenez.
86' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Ollie Watkins will be replaced by Tammy Abraham (Aston Villa).
86' The referee signals a substitution. Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Lucas Digne.
86' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
84' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
83' A quickly taken corner by Aston Villa.
83' Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
81' The corner kick from Amine Adli (Bournemouth) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
80' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
80' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the top left corner, but Emiliano Martinez gets a hand to it and keeps it out.
78' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
78' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The referee signals a corner kick to Bournemouth.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch so that Jadon Sancho can be given a rest.
77' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Douglas Luiz is replaced by Ross Barkley (Aston Villa).
77' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
75' The attendance for today's match is 11248.
74' A corner kick by Bournemouth is thwarted by the well prepared Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).
73' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bournemouth, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

72' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Anthony Taylor no option but to blow his whistle. Bournemouth get a free kick.
69' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Bournemouth, play can continue.
68' There's a break in play and referee Anthony Taylor must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bournemouth using VAR. This could be interesting!
67' PENALTY APPEAL after Evanilson (Bournemouth) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
66' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) replacing Emiliano Buendia.

66' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to keep the ball from hitting the net.
65' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) for Eli Junior Kroupi.
65' Emiliano Martinez displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Evanilson (Bournemouth) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
64' Aston Villa force a corner. They send men into the box.
63' Superb touch by Matty Cash (Aston Villa) as he receives a precise pass into the box, but the goalkeeper stops the ball as it heads towards the top of the net. Brilliant save!
62' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
60' A goal, which was scored by Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth), was disallowed due to offside.
60' That was close by Amine Adli (Bournemouth)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
59' Rayan (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
55' 1 - 1 Goal! Rayan (Bournemouth) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:1.
52' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Amine Adli (Bournemouth) heads on.
50' Bournemouth are enjoying a spell of pressure at the moment, but one of the defenders gets it clear.
47' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.
47' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
46' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
46' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Aston Villa.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking James Hill (Bournemouth), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
45+2' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) sprays a pass out to Ollie Watkins, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
45+1' The current number of corner kicks is 4:0.

45' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
45' Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
43' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
43' James Hill (Bournemouth) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
41' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
37' Bournemouth string together a series of short passes.
35' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
35' The booking goes to Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa).
34' Rayan (Bournemouth) places a close-range header from a rebound onto the crossbar!
34' The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
34' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Emiliano Martinez.
32' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
30' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) commits a foul and Anthony Taylor immediately signals a free kick.
29' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
28' Bournemouth hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
27' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
26' Evanilson (Bournemouth) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
24' Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player.
22' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Jadon Sancho tees up Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) inside the box and he curls the ball into the top right corner and past Djordje Petrovic.
21' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) has a goal ruled out for offside!
19' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
19' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) receives the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post!
17' Evanilson (Bournemouth) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
15' The current number of shots on goal is 3:0.
13' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.

12' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) wastes a huge opportunity. He attempts to knock a rebound into the middle of the goal with a delicate header, but Emiliano Martinez dives to keep the ball from hitting the net.

12' A neat pass is well received by Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot.
11' Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
11' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
10' Anthony Taylor interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth).
9' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
9' Bournemouth have a corner.
8' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.
7' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
7' Aston Villa players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
4' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
2' Jadon Sancho (Aston Villa) passes the ball and slows down the tempo so his team can continue with their combination play.
